events.title: Denver Arts Week: Free Night at Wings Over the Rockies Air and Space Museum
events.location: Wings Over the Rockies Air & Space Museum, 7711 East Academy Blvd, Denver, CO 80230
events.cost: Free general admission with free ticket; optional MaxFlight simulator costs extra
events.description: Official aviation museum one-night free after-hours opening for Denver Arts Week with a recently restored Thunderbird F-16D, real aircraft on display, STEAM hands-on activities, and museum open at night. Free ticket available on museum's event page. Distinct from its everyday regular-price museum admission. Do not imply aircraft cockpit entry or free simulator.
